dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Maybe a sled isn't that dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: Right? I've always wanted to modify a sled so I could actually catch up to a train!

dialogues.speaker: Belsky
dialogues.text: But when Dad found out, he banned me from touching sleds ever again, and he's been telling me how super, super dangerous they are...
